description: Assessment scheduler daemon. Coordinates reassessment timing to avoid all daemons running simultaneously. Maintains SCHEDULE.md with next_run times per daemon. Priority reassessment: servers with expired attestations, servers with new threat intel since last assessment, servers where verdict=INSUFFICIENT and 24h have passed. Emits schedule_trigger mesh_events that signal_analyser and trust_synthesiser listen to. Poll 900s. Ensures max 5 concurrent assessments. Heartbeat.
